title: What If Your CRUSH Turned Into a CAT and Only You Knew?
tags: what if you were a cat
what if your crush turned into a cat
description:
One week. That's how long Lia has before it's permanent. It starts with one ear under her hair, then a hoodie she won't take off, then a purr in the middle of class. Nobody can find out. And you're the only one who knows.

Two questions for the comments:
1) What animal would your crush turn into?
2) Would you have climbed up on those lockers, yes or no?

Subscribe so you don't miss what happens after the bike racks.

Real facts in this episode: a cat's purr sits between about 25 and 150 Hz, and cats also purr when scared or hurt; cat allergies come mostly from a protein called Fel d 1; cats sleep 12 to 16 hours a day; cats can't taste sweetness (2005 study); the righting reflex lets them turn in midair; the tapetum lucidum makes their eyes shine and lets them see in about one sixth of the light we need; a slow blink is the closest thing a cat has to a smile (University of Sussex, 2020).

#whatif #gusmaybe #cat #crush #animation
